subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp and preview land now, or be folded into the broader sessions overview direction?
rationale: The backend and TUI already support preview text, but the visible Control UI list design overlaps with broader open session overview, sorting, and derived-title work.

options.title: Land the narrow preview
options.body: Review or replace the existing attempts with a focused Control UI change that requests includeLastMessage and renders the preview in the current Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into overview design
options.body: Keep this issue linked to the broader sessions workspace direction and avoid a one-off table change until that design is settled.

options.title: Defer preview UX
options.body: Leave the Sessions table as a technical management view for now and close implementation attempts with a maintainer-stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow preview
recommendation.body: Review or replace the existing attempts with a focused Control UI change that requests includeLastMessage and renders the preview in the current Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Sessions page history and can route the narrow-vs-broader Control UI product decision.
